description: Create a universe. Creates a new universe. Only `name` is required — `unit_type` defaults to `user_id` and `holdout_range` defaults to `null` (no holdout).

description.description: Human-readable blurb shown in the universe picker/hovercard.

folder.description: Optional folder name grouping items in the dashboard. Alphanumeric, `_` or `-` (no `/`). Part of the SDK lookup key (`<folder>/<name>`).

holdout_range.description: Inclusive `[lo, hi]` bucket range (0–9999) reserved as the **holdout** — callers hashed into this slice are excluded from every experiment in the universe. `null` disables the holdout. Pro plan or higher required.

listToken.description: REQUIRED. The `listToken` returned by the most recent `release_experiments_universes_list` call. It proves you listed existing release experiments universes and confirmed this one doesn't already exist before creating it. Call `release_experiments_universes_list` first if you don't have a fresh token.

name.description: Stable universe key. Single segment or `folder.name`. Lowercase letters, digits, `_` or `-`; max 128 chars. Immutable after create.

anyOf.description: The universe's ordered config schema — the single source of truth for its params.

default.description: Universe-wide default. Returned when the assigned variant doesn't override this param (resolution: variant override → universe default).

name.description: Param key, referenced by `groups[].params` on every experiment in the universe.

type.description: Scalar type of the param's value.

param_schema.description: The universe-owned config schema — an ordered `{ name, type, default }[]`. Experiments may only override values per variant, never add fields. `null` starts an empty schema.

recommended_headroom.description: Basis points of reserved headroom seeded into each new experiment created in this universe (0 = none). Lets variants be appended into a running experiment without reshuffling.

unit_type.description: Unit of randomisation. Typically `user_id`. Use `account_id` to keep whole accounts in the same group across an experiment.

name: release_experiments_universes_create
